subject: Reassignment request: AWS SKU mapping / revenue reconciliation
messages:
From: AcmeSoft Billing <billing@acmesoft.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice question — May AWS Marketplace SKUs

Hi Soojin / Lauren,

Attached is our May AWS Marketplace invoice (acmesoft_aws_invoice_may2027.pdf) — line items under the 'redwood:compute' family appear to show revenue posted to two separate seller entities in AWS's CSV export we pulled (see attached sku_usage_export.csv). Our accounting team says revenue was all meant for the primary AcmeSoft entity (AcmeSoft, Inc., EIN ending 4321) and the split is causing duplicate VAT reclaim attempts on our side.

Can you confirm whether Redwood submitted multiple seller IDs for the same SKUs in May or whether this is an AWS metering export issue? We need a reconciliation and a suggested journal entry we can pass to our AP team; if Redwood can provide a corrected mapping or a written statement to AWS, that would help us avoid a VAT reclaim.

Attachments: acmesoft_aws_invoice_may2027.pdf (invoice, 2 pages), sku_usage_export.csv (AWS SKU-level usage, 24 rows)

Thanks,
Maya Patel

Hi Maya — thanks for the detailed note and attachments. I'm pulling the internal mapping and the ledger file and have looped in Marcus from Billing and Lauren from Marketplace Partnerships to help triage.

Quick summary of next steps from our side: 
- Marcus will confirm how the SKUs were registered in our AWS listing and whether any seller mapping changed in the May billing window.
- We'll compare Redwood's matching_ledger (internal) to your sku_usage_export and identify any divergent seller IDs.
- If there's a submission error on our side, we'll prepare a short statement for your AP team and coordinate with AWS Marketplace support for a correction.

I'll aim to get an initial reconciliation by EOD tomorrow (Wed). If we need an RFC with AWS, we'll escalate immediately.

Soojin Lee
Sr. Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0193

Attachment: redwood_matching_ledger.xlsx (draft) — internal ledger for matching SKUs to entity IDs
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Maya Patel <billing@acmesoft.com>, aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice question — May AWS Marketplace SKUs

Hi team — I pulled the listing config and the marketplace seller mapping for the date range May 1—May 31, 2027. Two things to flag: 
1) On May 4 we deployed a new listing that included a temporary migration token for legacy reporting; that change caused a subset of metering events for the 'redwood:compute:standard' SKU to be routed to our secondary entity (seller_id: RED-ENT-02) in AWS's export.
2) The mapping change should not have caused duplicate gross charges to the buyer, but it does appear in AWS's usage CSV as two rows with the same consumption metrics under different seller_ids — which leads to double counting in downstream VAT reports if reconciled naively.

Proposed fixes: 
- We'll generate a reconciliation file that consolidates the two seller IDs into the primary entity for your ledger and provide a short attestation letter you can submit to your tax advisor and AWS.
- For anything already paid, we can request an allocation correction via AWS Seller Support and provide the ledger mapping to speed their processing.

I can produce the consolidated reconciliation by COB Wed (12th). Attaching the preliminary matching ledger (redwood_matching_ledger.xlsx) and a delta CSV.

Marcus Lin
Billing Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: redwood_matching_ledger.xlsx (updated v2), reconciliation_delta.csv
From: AcmeSoft Billing <billing@acmesoft.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice question — May AWS Marketplace SKUs

Thanks Marcus — this is helpful. Two quick clarifying asks from our accounting lead: 
1) Can Redwood provide the exact timestamps (UTC) when the seller_id switch was active in the listing? We need to map consumption by hour for VAT period closing.
2) Will Redwood draft the attestation letter as a short PDF on Redwood letterhead that explicitly states all revenue should be assigned to AcmeSoft (primary seller entity)? If so, please include the AWS request ticket number when you open it so we can reference it in our case.

If you can include a suggested journal entry (debit/credit lines) for our AP to apply against the duplicate lines, that would also speed our month-end close.

Appreciate the quick turn — happy to hop on a 30-min call if helpful.

Maya
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Maya Patel <billing@acmesoft.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice question — May AWS Marketplace SKUs

Maya — quick update and plan of record: 

Summary of findings (short): 
- Root cause: a deployment on 2027-05-04 introduced a temporary migration token that caused a subset (~1.7% of usage rows) of 'redwood:compute:standard' events to be attributed to RED-ENT-02 in AWS's SKU export.
- Impact: duplicate appearance in CSV exports; gross charges on invoice remain singular, but VAT reporting tools that aggregate by seller_id will show duplicates.

Deliverables we'll send by EOD tomorrow (Fri): 
1) Consolidated reconciliation CSV with matched_usage_id and final_seller_id (for your ledger).
2) Redwood attestation PDF (letter on Redwood Inference letterhead) confirming revenue assignment to AcmeSoft primary entity with signed name from Finance.
3) Draft journal entry suggestion (two-line credit/debit) you can give to AP.
4) AWS ticket number once opened and a proposed request text for allocation correction.

Next steps: Marcus will open the AWS Seller Support ticket this afternoon and paste the ticket ID into this thread. Lauren will reach out to AWS contact if we hit a support queue delay. I'll share the pack as attachments and a short one-page summary for your tax team.

Would you like us to route the attestation via DocuSign or as a signed PDF?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sr. Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
